note: OURS, not 0.75's: Noria has no guards in Version075 or in MuMain. right_hand_from: Ours: the Tiger Bow, the best of the elves' bows in 0.75, as a guard's Light Crossbow is a real one. Held as Peia holds hers; a bow's hand is the engine's business.
female_from: The Fairy Elf's own body and clips, as Peia.
idle_from: PLAYER_STOP_FEMALE on a safe tile. She is posted one tile OUTSIDE the safe bit at each road, as four of Lorencia's six guards are, so the tile gives her PLAYER_STOP_BOW with the bow up; action2 is her stance only if she is walked back into the town.
